changes: Initial hand-curated BigQuery data-warehouse connector (source + destination, batch).
Optimized reads: keyset/offset paginated export (next_cursor/has_more) that resumes large tables to EOF.
Optimized writes: flag-gated bulk NDJSON load jobs (RSYNC_BQ_LOAD_JOB) with streaming fallback, advertised via DestinationLoadSpec(load_method=bq_load_job).
Delegates to shared BigQueryWarehouseAdapter; CDC merge/offset code present but dormant (supports_cdc=false).
